timecoded_text_to_speech.text: I absolutely love how you saw the panel. You've said, I'm not here as a princess. I'm not here to present the state. I'm here as a human being.
I just think it's very opposite to what I'm really expected.

And then you give this very strong message of how it's all rising out and trying to do something about it as opposed to talking about what's coming and what's coming to a good point out is just self-destruction.
So I just wanted to ask you, what are some of the specific things that you're involved in that go on the way of just addressing this big issue?
The whole core of this is that we're not connected to where we are. And so I made that my mission in life to connect people to where they are.
So that's the core of it.
So everybody has to reconnect to our core. We have immense powers as human beings, but we have decided not to believe that we have those powers.
We can move mountains, we can change this world into the harmony that is supposed to be in.
But we have gone so far down the wrong line. And I think that our age people were already going on one track and it's hard for us to change our minds and our ways of living.
In that respect, as I started also looking towards the young, with Gideotl Tuenberg, who is an amazing example.
She has autism, she is mute, but she speaks up and she starts, the Swedish girl is 16.
And she started by herself, you know, demonstrating for a climate every Friday out of school and there's a whole movement now only in 33 Fridays.
That strength is something we all have and can do something about.
We are in a room full of leaders from all over the world who have powers above what she had to start with.
She can move millions, so we can as well.
But we have to look at the young because they haven't got these ways of seeing the world so set yet.
So we have to like trust them and look towards them to find new solutions.
How can social media help us? How can we use tech in new ways that we haven't thought of?
How can we amplify and make new technology that actually assists us in remembering who we are instead of just depleting us from what we are?
And I think that is a very important aspect that we have to focus on and we have to sit together, like I said, like brothers and sisters, and not have this duality of me versus you, us versus them.
I'm better than you, I'm worse than you, I'm women therefore I'm less than you or more than you.
We have to rise above all these things. All our egos, all our different things and actually save this planet.
I think it's pretty incredible to hear this message from somebody like you, where traditionally I think people kind of look at this situation of world.
It's us versus you, where better you're worse. So I think you being part of this conversation and trying to do something about it by itself is incredibly inspiring and eye-opening.
And I was just curious, there are so many events around the world and we are here, like you said, the global leaders and the Portugal gathering today and for the next few days.
Do you see a lot of conversations about the topic? Only or do you actually beginning to see some action behind those conversations?
I want to see more doing. I think we have to act as the House of Sun fire. I think we have to act as though there's a huge crisis going on because there is.
We should act because we are scared that we will perish. And I don't see that reaction yet.
There are particular like one project, one team that you'd like to share with the audience that you are behind that you'd like to see move forward. Is anything in particular?
We have to empower each and every one because very many find that, oh, we need to save our planet and I don't know what to do.
We have to have simple programs for each and every one of us to do something. And also, of course, on a global scale.

And so, therefore, we have to get the power back in people's hands so that we can actually change. And there are so many people who do amazing things in the world for climate and also for women and for equality in the world in all different areas.
And so, we have to all step up and go together and really join hands and see ourselves as brothers and sisters and do something for this global village.

I hope your message comes through and I think with the technology and with everything that's happening more and more people get empowered because they get more and more information, they get better educated.

And I just wanted to thank you for your role in this. I think you're very inspiring. And it just, again, it's just incredible to see what's going on in events like this when people from all over the world gather and from different perspectives, different backgrounds and try to make something great happen.
Yes. I know you have a crazy schedule and I take any more of your time, but you'd be very generous with your time and I appreciate it very much. Very much to do. Thank you.
Thank you.
